titre: Adoption de l'IA par secteur aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Part des entreprises déclarant utiliser l'IA, en %, au 3 mai 2026

Information.texte: the AI use rates in the Information (39.7%) and Finance and Insurance (33.9%) sectors were both higher than the national rate (19.8%)

Finance et assurance.texte: the AI use rates in the Information (39.7%) and Finance and Insurance (33.9%) sectors were both higher than the national rate (19.8%)

Ensemble des entreprises.texte: were both higher than the national rate (19.8%) but neither reported significant shifts since December

Commerce de détail.texte: around 14% of businesses currently use AI, and about 17% expect to in the next six months
